en.label: [section] Aim of the course and learning outcomes:
en.content: Aim of the course is to acquaint students with the principles of operation, possibilities and limitations of automation technology in general and in various types of wood production. Emphasis is placed on the ability to communicate in partnership with manufacturers and suppliers of automated systems and assess the suitability of the application of the systems in the given conditions.
